files.content:
html {
  block-size: 100%;
}

body {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
  background: url(https://code.s3.yandex.net/web-code/images/dotted-l.svg);
  block-size: 100%;
}

.medal {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  align-self: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: solid 1px transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  padding: 3px;
  color: transparent;
  font-family: 'Book Antiqua', serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 8rem;
  text-shadow: -1px -1px #000, 0 1px 0 #444;
  inline-size: 250px;
  block-size: 250px;
}

.medal:nth-child(1) {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 5px #eedc00, inset 0 5px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5),
    inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0 0 0 / 0.5);
  color: #edc800;
  background-image:
    conic-gradient(
      #edc800,
      #e3b600,
      #f3cf00,
      #ffe800,
      #ffe900,
      #ffeb00,
      #ffe000,
      #ebc500,
      #e0b100,
      #f1cc00,
      #fcdc00,
      #ffe500,
      #fad900,
      #eec200,
      #e7b900,
      #f7d300,
      #ffe800,
      #ffe300,
      #f5d100,
      #e6b900,
      #e3b600,
      #f4d000,
      #ffe400,
      #ebc600,
      #e3b600,
      #f6d500,
      #ffe900,
      #ffe90a,
      #edc800
    );
}

.medal:nth-child(2) {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 5px #c9c9c9, inset 0 1px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5),
    inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0 0 0 / 0.5);
  color: #ccc;
  background-image:
    conic-gradient(
      #d7d7d7,
      #c3c3c3,
      #ccc,
      #c6c6c6,
      #d3d3d3,
      #d8d8d8,

      #d1d1d1,
      #c5c5c5,
      #c8c8c8,
      #d7d7d7,
      #d5d5d5,
      #cdcdcd,
      #c4c4c4,
      #d9d9d9,
      #cecece,
      #c5c5c5,
      #c5c5c5,
      #cdcdcd,
      #d8d8d8,
      #d9d9d9,
      #d7d7d7
    );
}

.medal:nth-child(3) {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 5px #b85137, inset 0 1px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5),
    inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0 0 0 / 0.5);
